method.build: fresh npm run build:arcade output (releaseSha 16b46aaa8c2d242057c099d593ca2eae20d95b72), exercised through the arcade portal checks and deployment smoke

designConformance.designClaim: The run starts with three coral, azure, and gold contracts; pointer drag steers, release drops, and a tap shorter than 180 ms spends gust before dropping.
designConformance.observed: The production runtime initializes the three distinct pending letters, maps a held pointer to the ship target, classifies an unmoved release below 180 ms as releaseGust, and routes longer or moved releases to drop.

designConformance.designClaim: Remaining in an updraft recovers altitude and charges stored gust up to three slots, with one slot available at the start.
designConformance.observed: The runtime starts at one gust and increments gust after 2.5 seconds inside the updraft up to three, but the inLift branch does not change ship y, vy, or any altitude resource. No altitude recovery effect is present in the production bundle.

designConformance.designClaim: A stored gust pushes nearby hazards away and briefly protects the hull.
designConformance.observed: releaseGust consumes one slot, grants 0.7 seconds of invulnerability, and displaces hazards within 130 design pixels away from the ship.

designConformance.designClaim: A release drops the matching undelivered letter at the nearest mailbox; delivery succeeds within 42 px and is precise within 20 px.
designConformance.observed: drop selects the nearest island whose seal letter is still pending, rejects distances above 42, and deliveryScore applies the precision branch at distances of 20 or less.

designConformance.designClaim: A successful delivery scores 1,000, with 400 precision and 250 dry bonuses; consecutive success multipliers progress x1.0, x1.5, x2.0 and a missed drop resets the multiplier.
designConformance.observed: deliveryScore composes the specified base bonuses and caps the combo multiplier at x2.0; successful drops increment combo and out-of-radius drops reset it.

designConformance.designClaim: The gold emergency contract adds 500 points when delivered last and 900 points when delivered no later than second.
designConformance.observed: Gold delivery adds 900 when fewer than two other letters are delivered and 500 otherwise.

designConformance.designClaim: An active lightning cloud or bird collision removes one of four hull slots, gives 1.2 seconds of invulnerability, wets the first still-undelivered dry letter, and wet letters lose the 250-point dry bonus.
designConformance.observed: The collision path decrements hull, assigns 1.2 seconds of invulnerability, calls wetFirstPending, resets combo, and wet delivery omits the dry bonus.

designConformance.designClaim: Hazards flow downward and recycle after passing the bottom, birds cross the route, and lightning cycles through 1 second warning, 0.65 seconds active damage, then cooldown with damage only while active.
designConformance.observed: All hazards advance downward and wrap to y=95; birds also have horizontal velocity and horizontal wrap. lightningPhase returns warning for the first 1 second, active until 1.65 seconds, and cooldown for the rest of its four-second cycle, while collision enables cloud damage only in active.

designConformance.designClaim: The seed determines all three island positions, updraft position, and cloud and bird placement; the destinations remain distinct colors and a traversable safe corridor from start to gate is always preserved.
designConformance.observed: Seeded logic controls island, updraft, cloud, and bird positions and the islands have three distinct seals. However, generateRoute only bounds island and updraft x positions, while nine hazards are placed independently over the route; there is no corridor construction or clearance validation from the start to the gate in source or production behavior.

designConformance.designClaim: The storm gate stays locked until all three contracts are delivered; passing the open top gate returns successfully, while zero hull or the six-minute limit ends in rescue failure.
designConformance.observed: canOpenGate requires all three letters delivered, the top-center gate collision finishes with rescued=true only afterward, and elapsed time at 360 seconds or hull at zero finishes with rescued=false.

designConformance.designClaim: Final score adds 8 points per whole remaining second and 250 per remaining hull slot; grades are S at 5,200, A at 4,200, B at 3,000, otherwise C, with rescue failure D; GameResult.phase is successful deliveries from 0 to 3.
designConformance.observed: finalScore and grade implement the stated formulas and boundaries, finish sends the count of delivered letters as phase, and the result screen displays grade, score, delivered count, and hull.

designConformance.designClaim: Each 1,000 final-score points awards one locally accumulated stamp; cosmetic-only hull, teal sail, and gold gust ring appearances unlock at 4, 9, and 15 stamps, with run-local fallback when storage is unavailable.
designConformance.observed: finish adds floor(total/1000), catches storage failure while retaining the in-memory total, and cosmeticTier plus drawShip apply the three visual thresholds without changing gameplay values.

designConformance.designClaim: Arrow keys or WASD steer, Space drops, Shift gusts, P pauses, M mutes, document deactivation auto-pauses, and WebAudio starts only after user input.
designConformance.observed: The production runtime binds all specified keys, pauses on visibilitychange when hidden, and calls StormAudio.unlock only from pointerdown or the M key; audio pause, mute, resume, and destroy lifecycle paths are present.

designConformance.designClaim: Korean and English provide the same gameplay rules and state information.
designConformance.observed: Both locales expose equivalent title, control, objective, hit, delivery, gate, pause, return/failure, and result information; the viewport run reached both localized result screens without errors or clipped result UI.

designConformance.designClaim: The game is a 390 by 844 portrait Canvas 2D experience with forward route motion in one screen.
designConformance.observed: The arcade portal laid out a 390 by 844 design canvas with uniform letterboxing; the 390 by 844 standalone and portal checks passed with correct aspect, DPR backing store, no overflow, and no console or page errors. Moving cloud layers and downward weather/hazards provide route motion.

creatorTests.covers: Delivery radius and scoring, wet-letter order, gate lock, return scoring and grade boundaries, seeded route, lightning phases, stamp rewards and cosmetic thresholds, seeded RNG, records, and bilingual shell translation completeness.

deployable.observed: Fresh npm run build and npm run build:arcade succeeded. The immutable arcade release verified all five required files and hashes (1,617,121 bytes; 92,423-byte JS gzip). CSP and missing-asset checks passed, 390x844 standalone and portal viewport checks passed, and deployment smoke mounted with zero console or page errors. sourceHash matched smoke-result.json.

notes: The verdict is blocked solely for concrete final-GDD conformance gaps: updraft altitude recovery and guaranteed safe-corridor generation. Build health and deployability passed.
Dependency audit severity and unverified device feel were not used as design-conformance criteria.

summary.ko: 제작자 테스트와 빌드·아케이드 배포 검증은 통과했지만, 상승 기류의 고도 회복과 시작점부터 관문까지의 안전 통로 보장이 구현되지 않아 출고를 막는다.
summary.en: Creator tests, builds, and arcade deployability checks pass, but release is blocked because updraft altitude recovery and a guaranteed safe corridor from start to gate are not implemented.
